name: SCARED Rating Scale
description: Screen for Child Anxiety Related Disorders (SCARED) — Parent version. 41 items covering five anxiety subscales (Panic/Somatic, Generalized Anxiety, Separation Anxiety, Social Anxiety, School Avoidance). Each subscale has its own cutoff; an overall score of 25 or more may indicate an anxiety disorder, 30 or more is more specific.
